JSON_EXISTS(                     json_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF8,                     'lax $[start_parameter TO end_parameter.ceiling()]'                         PASSING                                 start_column AS start_parameter,                                 end_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF16 AS end_parameter                     UNKNOWN ON ERROR)

JSON_VALUE(                     json_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF8,                     'lax $[start_parameter TO end_parameter.ceiling()]'                         PASSING                                 start_column AS start_parameter,                                 end_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF16 AS end_parameter                     RETURNING double                     DEFAULT 5e0 ON EMPTY                     ERROR ON ERROR)

JSON_QUERY(                     json_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF8,                     'lax $[start_parameter TO end_parameter.ceiling()]'                         PASSING                                 start_column AS start_parameter,                                 end_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF16 AS end_parameter                     RETURNING varchar FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF32                     WITH ARRAY WRAPPER                     OMIT QUOTES                     EMPTY ARRAY ON EMPTY                     ERROR ON ERROR)

JSON_OBJECT(                      key_column_1 VALUE value_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF16,                      KEY 'key_literal' VALUE 5,                      key_column_2 : null                      ABSENT ON NULL                      WITH UNIQUE KEYS                      RETURNING varbinary FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF32)

JSON_ARRAY(value_column FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF16,                     5,                     null                     NULL ON NULL                     RETURNING varbinary FORMAT JSON ENCODING UTF32)
